post.description: As well as supporting individual payment requests, the Modulr payment platform can also handle multiple payment objects in the same request. This endpoint allows you to make a new batch payment.

source.description: Origin of the name check result, could be MODULR or EXTERNAL

payment.PaymentApproval.description: A single approval against a batch payment request

approvedBy.description: ID of user who approved this batch payment request

id.description: Unique id for the Batch Payment. 10 characters long

totalPayments.description: Total count of payments in this batch

currentUserCanApprove.description: Whether the user is allowed to approve this batch, based on their approval limits, and applicable configuration

paymentDetails.description: Summary of payments and approvals, per currency (as a 3-alpha currency code)

currentUserCanCancel.description: Whether the user is allowed and currently able to cancel at least one of the payments in this batch

createdDate.description: Datetime when the batch payment was created. Format is 'yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ' where Z is UTC offset. e.g 2017-01-28T01:01:01+0000

createdBy.description: ID of the user that created the payment

processingDateFrom.description: Earliest processing date in the batch file or the batch creation date if the file does not have any dates. Date format 'yyyy-MM-dd'

processingDateTo.description: Last processing date in the batch file or empty if the file does not have any dates. Date format 'Format is 'yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ' where Z is UTC offset. e.g 2017-01-28T01:01:01+0000'

earliestScheduledPaymentDate.description: Earliest processing date in the batch file or empty if the file does not have any dates. Date format 'Format is 'yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ' where Z is UTC offset. e.g 2017-01-28T01:01:01+0000'

requiredApprovalCount.description: The number of required approvals for the batch.  Applicable to batch payments of submissionType BATCH

batchSummary.description: Summary of the state of payment requests in this batch

strict.description: Strict processing flag. Whether the entire batch should fail on any individual payment validation failure

summary.description: Summary of the state of payment requests in this batch

bearer.description: Information about bearer of the charges. Its can be Creditor, Debtor or shared between both

amount.description: Amount of the charges. Max allowed is 999999999999.99

currency.description: Currency of charge. Should be ISO Standard currency

total.description: Total count of payment requests in this batch

inprogress.description: Count of payment requests in progress

info.description: Additional information or error message regarding this batch payment request

quoteId.description: Quote Id for foreign exchange trade

currency.description: Currency of the account in ISO 4217 format. Default is GBP

amount.description: Amount of the payment in Major Current Units - '1' = 1.00 GBP

reference.description: Reference to be used for the Payment. This will appear on the Account statement/the recipient's bank account. Min 6 to max 18 characters that are not all the same (up to 140 characters for currencies other than GBP). Can contain alphanumeric, '-', '.', '&', '/' and space.

endToEndReference.description: Optional end to end reference. For international payments, Modulr payment ID will be used as end-to-end reference.

paymentDate.description:
The future date on which to make the payment. Date format 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

Not applicable for international payments which will be submitted on date of submission or next working day, in line with cut-offs.

overseasPaymentDetail.description:
Details relating to payment originated overseas.

Not applicable for international payments - all international transactions must originate from the Modulr account creating the payment request.

purposeOfPayment.description: A code from the UK Recommended Purpose Code list that indicates the type of Payment. This is optional for most payment types but recommended to be completed where possible; where it is required for certain purposes of CHAPS payment if not supplied a default value will be used

categoryOfPayment.description: A category code from the UK Recommended Purpose Code list that indicates the general category of the Payment. This is optional for all types of payment, and defaults to 'OTHR' on schemes that accept category

permittedScheme.description: Attempt to process the payment using only the specified scheme

nameCheck.description: Reference to name check result for the destination account.

authorityCountry.description: ISO 3166 country code of the ultimate payers address

type.description: Indicates the type of destination. IBAN type is required for international payments.

id.description: Identifier for the Payment destination if using ACCOUNT or BENEFICIARY type. Can be either: a) Beneficiary id for an external Payment, b) Account id for a transfer to another Account

iban.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN). To be used as the destination identifier when sending ‘IBAN’ type payments

accountNumber.description: Account Number of destination account if using SCAN type.

sortCode.description: Sort Code of destination account if using SCAN type.

name.description: Name to use if a new beneficiary is created, and for using as the payee name if SCAN or IBAN types are specified for the destination

address.description: Optional address. Mandatory for international payments.

birthdate.description: The destination beneficiary's date of birth. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

bic.description: The destination beneficiary's SWIFT BIC (Bank Identifier Code). Only to be used for international payments.

countrySpecificDetails.description: Further details required, depending on the destination's country

legalEntityIdentifier.description: The destination beneficiary's Legal entity Identifier

pendingApprovalCount.description: Count of payments currently pending approval

pendingApprovalAmount.description: Sum total of payment amounts currently pending approval

bankName.description: The name of the destination bank.

bankAddress.description: The address of the destination bank.

bankCity.description: The city in which the destination bank resides.

bankBranchName.description: The name of the destination bank's branch.

bankBranchCode.description: The code of the destination bank's branch.

bankCode.description: The code identifying the target bank on its respective national network. This is not the BIC/SWIFT code. This is known as the 'ABA code' in the U.S., 'ISFC' in India, 'routing number' in Canada, and so on.

chineseId.description: The 18 digit identification code of the beneficiary. Applies to Chinese beneficiaries only.

province.description: The province in which the beneficiary resides. Applies only to beneficiaries residing in China.

abaRoutingNumber.description: The 9 digit identification code of the beneficiary. Applies to US beneficiaries only.

business.description: The type of the beneficiary. 'true' for businesses, 'false' otherwise.

bankCodeType.description:
The code type identifying the target bank on its respective national network.
This is known as the 'ABA code' in the U.S., 'ISFC' in India, 'routing number' in Canada, and so on.

bankCountry.description: The country in which the destination bank resides. Mandatory for international payments.

total.description: Total count of payment requests in this batch

inprogress.description: Count of payment requests in progress

info.description: Additional information or error message regarding this batch payment request

addressLine1.description: First line of the ultimate payers address

addressLine2.description: Second line of the ultimate payers address

postTown.description: Postal town of the ultimate payers address

postCode.description: Post code of the ultimate payers address

country.description: ISO 3166 country code of the ultimate payers address

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format of the ultimate payer

cityOfBirth.description: City of birth of the ultimate payer

countryOfBirth.description: ISO 3166 country code of the ultimate payers country of birth

externalReference.description: Your reference for this Batch of payments

strictProcessing.description: Flag to control if the entire batch fails for any individual payment validation failure

submissionType.description: BATCH restricts operations to batch level.  BULK (default) allows payment level operations such as approval

amount.description: Amount of currency that the payment is in

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code that the amount is in

amount.description: Amount of the payment in Major Current Units - '1' = 1.00 GBP

currencyCode.description: Currency of the account in ISO 4217 format. Default is GBP

birthDetails.description: Birth details of a person. Official identification details. Property 'birthDetails' and/or 'officialIdentification' Or 'officialIdDetailOrgs' is mandatory

officialIdentification.description: Official identification for a person. Property 'birthDetails' and/or 'officialIdentification' Or 'officialIdDetailOrgs' is mandatory

officialIdDetailOrgs.description: Organisation's official identification. Official identification details. Property 'birthDetails' and/or 'officialIdentification' Or 'officialIdDetailOrgs' is mandatory
